statement: Claude Code's official Agent Teams documentation describes an experimental lead-and-teammates model with independent context windows, a shared task list, and direct teammate messaging; it also states that teammates do not receive automatic worktree isolation.

display_text.zh-CN: Claude Code 官方 Agent Teams 文档描述了一种实验性的 lead-and-teammates 模型：每个 teammate 拥有独立 context window，共享 task list，并可直接互发消息；文档同时说明 teammate 不会自动获得 worktree 隔离。
display_text.en: Claude Code's official Agent Teams documentation describes experimental lead-and-teammate coordination with independent context windows, a shared task list, direct messaging, and no automatic worktree isolation.

evidence.title: Claude Code Agent Teams
evidence.locator: How agent teams work, comparison with subagents, enablement, and limitations

notes: This is an official product-contract claim for an experimental feature, not a claim about closed-core implementation details or effective workspace isolation.
